newsitem.title: USA: Amway sees Q4 net sales level with last Q4.
newsitem.headline: Amway sees Q4 net sales level with last Q4.

text.p: Amway Asia Pacific said Friday that in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1997, net sales for the company are expected to be generally level with the fourth quarter of last year.
The company reported net sales of $198.3 million for the fourth quarter last year.

The company said it expects to report strong net sales growth in fiscal 1997, as compared to fiscal 1996, due to increased net sales in China which has become a significant contributor to both sales and income.

The company said China net sales in the near term are expected to slow from the pace of recent quarters as the company and the distributor leadership build operations in the new cities and provinces in China.
The company said this diverts the focus of the distributor leadership away from their existing business development efforts.
